qa.reason: Partly checked on an Android emulator with mock providers. Phone and full harness support are not verified.

notes.en:
Herdline 0.6.63 (Experimental)

- Equal-height tab cards; separate card and menu actions.
- Compact, horizontally scrolling category filters with counts.
- Large-font Order choices scroll instead of clipping “Last activity”.
- OMP PTY sends confirm after the exact submitted text appears in history, including trimmed edge spaces/newlines; the editor clears and the next Send works without Unlock.
- Includes Chat/Terminal navigation, header, extra-key and Tabs-dismissal fixes since 0.6.34.

Checked on an Android emulator with stock Herdr 0.9.5 and mock providers, not a phone. Harness support is incomplete. Claude Code Send remains blocked on Herdr 0.9.5. Old held deliveries need one explicit Unlock. Attachments and runtime text rewrites may remain unconfirmed; check before resending. No automatic resend or auto-reconnect guarantee.

Full notes: https://github.com/erikfrish/herdline/releases/tag/v0.6.63
